subjects: a lecture being captured (a room, a screen, a speaker)
the moment a student stops writing and starts listening
the jump from a line of notes back to the audio it came from
composition: main subjects remain visible and uncropped
legible on a narrow phone screen
text_policy: narrative raster assets carry one short title plus one short subtitle; icons, SVGs, logos, and tiny helper graphics remain text-free

brand-reference.purpose: placeholder mark committed with the adapter; not a designed brand and not a narrative asset

reject_when: fake metrics, invented statistics, or invented screenshots
tiny unreadable labels on a phone screen
images that show a real student's name, lecture recording, or institution without consent
stock imagery implying a product that does not exist yet
